<parameter name="content"># Claude Code context layout for `atlas`

Principle: always-loaded context holds only what applies to every task. Directory quirks load only when Claude works in that directory. Long procedures load on demand. Hard guarantees are enforced by config or hooks, not prose. External systems connect through MCP.

## Files and mechanisms

| Location | Mechanism | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` (root) | Always-loaded memory | Org-wide conventions (conventional commits, `make check`, trunk-based) apply to every task in all three services. |
| `api/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md, loaded when Claude touches files under `api/` | The Go/gRPC quirk (`api/gen/` is generated by `make proto`) is irrelevant to web and pipeline work, so it stays out of the root. |
| `web/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | Tells Claude to use `npm run test:unit` and avoid `npm test`, which launches real Playwright browsers. |
| `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | Explains that `AIRFLOW_HOME` must be `pipeline/.airflow` before DAGs import, and how to set it per command. |
| `.claude/settings.json` | Project permissions (checked in) | Denies `Edit`/`Write` on `api/gen/**` and denies bare `npm test`. It also allows `make check` and `make proto` without prompting. This is enforcement, so it does not depend on Claude remembering a note. |
| `.claude/hooks/block-gen-edits.sh` (PreToolUse hook, registered in `settings.json`) | Hook | Backstop for `api/gen/` that also catches edits made through shell commands (`sed -i`, redirects). The error message points Claude to `make proto`. |
| `.claude/skills/incident-response/SKILL.md` | Skill (on-demand, invoked by name or by matching description) | The 20-step runbook is long, procedural, and only needed during incidents. It costs no context until used. Put numbered steps in the skill body and long reference tables in sibling files. |
| Company-wide plugin (preferred home for the runbook skill) | Plugin / marketplace | Every team uses the runbook identically, so one versioned source avoids per-repo copies drifting. Install it in `atlas` via `enabledPlugins` in `settings.json`. If no plugin marketplace exists yet, keep the skill in the repo and move it later. |
| `.mcp.json` (warehouse server) | MCP server | Live SQL against the warehouse is a tool, not knowledge. Use a **read-only** warehouse role with credentials from env vars, never committed. |
| `.claude/settings.json` MCP allow/deny rules | Permissions | Auto-allow the read-only query tool. Keep any write-capable tool off. |
| `.claude/skills/product-metrics/SKILL.md` (optional) | Skill | Holds the analysts' metric definitions, key tables, and query etiquette (limits, partition filters). It loads only for metrics questions and does not weigh down engineers' sessions. |
| `CLAUDE.local.md` / `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Personal memory (gitignored / user-level) | Individual preferences and local paths stay out of the shared repo. |

## What is deliberately not in the root CLAUDE.md
- The runbook. It is 20 steps, rarely needed, and company-wide, so it lives in a skill/plugin.
- Warehouse access details. They belong in MCP config and the optional metrics skill.
- Service quirks. They live in nested files next to the code they describe.
- Anything derivable from the code, such as directory trees or dependency lists.

## Caveats
- Nested CLAUDE.md files load when Claude reads or edits files in that subtree. A session started at the root that only runs commands may not see them. The root file therefore carries a one-line pointer to each.
- Permission rules and hooks should be tested once after setup, since the exact pattern syntax matters.
- Warehouse safety depends on the database role's grants. The MCP config alone is not a security boundary.

<parameter name="content"># atlas

Monorepo with three services:

- `api/` — Go, gRPC
- `web/` — React/TypeScript
- `pipeline/` — Python, Airflow

## Org-wide conventions

- Use conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, etc.).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: short-lived branches only, no long-lived branches.

## Service-specific notes

Each service has its own `CLAUDE.md`. Read it before working in that directory:

- `api/CLAUDE.md` — never hand-edit `api/gen/`; regenerate with `make proto`.
- `web/CLAUDE.md` — use `npm run test:unit`, not `npm test` (opens real browsers).
- `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` — set `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` before importing DAGs.

## Other tooling

- Incident response: use the `incident-response` skill to walk through the company runbook.
- Product metrics: use the warehouse MCP server (read-only) for SQL questions.
